name: LB-series courier droid
description: The LB-series courier droid was developed by Industrial Automaton during the Galactic Civil War. Only a few hundred were made during the initial test run, including LB-K2. The LB series was designed to be a reasoning commuications device, capable of both intra-system data transfer, and normal "life-form" communications. Thus, it functions both in Class two and Class three applications.
